incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org=catalystcorp — sudden QPS spike detected (5m p95 latency 1.4s, 5m error rate 12% (503)). Paging oncall for incidents/incidents.
marta-sre: Oncall marta here, grabbing context.
sanjay-eng: I'm seeing massive KV cache churn and long seqs. Lots of streaming sessions staying open.
dee-rt: Confirmed — streaming sessions up ~8x baseline. Logs show `kv_cache_evictions` rising and per-worker token queue growth.
jess-am: Looping AM. Messaging Catalyst to check whether this is expected traffic.
ops-bot: Metrics snapshot: cpu/gpu load at 85%, token throughput +310%, queue depth spiking on inference-workers-7..12.
marta-sre: Quick mitigation plan:
- soft override RL for org:catalystcorp (avoid hard 503s)
- disable streaming for new sessions (force polling)
- route new requests to rdx-small-v1 model variant
- reduce max_tokens for org to 512
- 30m watch then reassess
sanjay-eng: I'll push the soft RL override now. Executing admin call.
sanjay-eng: ```
# internal admin API
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/orgs/catalystcorp/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"rate_limit": {"requests_per_min": 12000, "burst": 24000, "soft": true}, "max_tokens": 512, "disable_streaming": true, "route_model": "rdx-small-v1", "ttl_minutes": 30}'
```
deploy-bot: Command accepted. Applying overrides to org:catalystcorp :gear:
ops-bot: Override applied (id=ovr_2026_3101_01) — status 200.
marta-sre: Monitoring metrics now — error rate down to 3%, p95 -> 680ms, queue depth decreasing. :white_check_mark:
jess-am: Notified Catalyst: "We applied a temporary, reversible override to keep you online while you investigate. We'll monitor and revert once stable." They replied: "Thanks, we just noticed an internal ramp in our experiment — rolling back on our side now." 
dee-rt: Logs still show a few tailing 503s; looks like older sessions are finishing. Streaming disable prevented new long-lived KV pressure.
sanjay-eng: Scheduling automated rollback in 35m unless we see regression. I'll leave a manual hold if AM asks to keep.
marta-sre: Adding follow-up items: postmortem entry, add per-org streaming circuit breaker (low cost), add alert that suggests automatic fallback to smaller model when kv_evictions > threshold.
jess-am: I'll coordinate with Catalyst for a formal incident summary and share SLA notes.
ops-bot: Post-deploy checks: all affected racks back under 70% load. No hotspots.
marta-sre: Good. Closing this page for active paging but keeping thread open for notes. If we see new spike, re-escalate.
incident-bot: Incident: mitigated — status: monitoring (auto-close in 2h if stable).
